key_findings: Gut microbiota depletion by antibiotics prevented or suppressed neuropathic pain after CCI, oxaliplatin and STZ diabetes in mice, and fecal bacteria transplantation restored the pain.
Microbiota depletion suppressed spinal glial activation after CCI and STZ, and suppressed oxaliplatin-induced IL-6 and TNF-alpha in DRG.
